about.text: Skimmed milk, or skim milk, is made when all the milkfat is removed from whole milk. It tends to contain around 0.1% to 0.3% fat.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: The cream is spun off the warm raw milk, which leaves almost no fat; what is left is then pasteurised like any milk. The fat on the label is whatever the dairy leaves in.
